messages:
mira_support: Hi — customer reported Python SDK streaming generator hang when response includes emoji/multibyte chars. Happens intermittently, often when auth refresh or retry occurs. Repro attached below.
jonathan_eng: Thanks. Can you paste the minimal repro and the exact SDK/server versions?
mira_support: Repro: user using redwood==0.10.2, server-side hosted API. Minimal snippet:
```
with Redwood.streaming_completion(model='redwood-3', prompt='say hi with emoji') as gen:
    for chunk in gen:
        print(chunk.text)
```
They get stuck after printing partial emoji like "...\ud83d" and generator never yields again.
mira_support: Logs show SSE events arriving but splitted mid-multibyte. Example raw chunk sequence (hex shown):
```
64 61 74 61 3a 20 7b 22 74 65 78 74 22 3a 20 22 48 69 20 3a 20 f0 9f 98 8a 22 7d 0a
```
Then a retry/backoff occurs and next chunk starts at later offset: `f0 9f` missing first bytes in second chunk -> decoder raises UnicodeDecodeError in some parse paths.
jonathan_eng: Hmm. That hex looks like a complete emoji in one chunk, but if the boundary splits inside the 4-byte UTF-8 sequence (e.g., you receive `f0 9f` then later `98 8a`) naive .decode() calls can throw or hang depending on parser. Do we have stacktrace from the generator hang?
mira_support: No hard crash — generator stalls (no StopIteration). From our logs the SSE parser returns a partial data event and the SDK's generator awaits more bytes but never gets resumed when keepalive/heartbeat is parsed as an empty event. See excerpt:
```
SSE recv: b'data: {"text": "Hi : \xf0\x9f\x98'
parser: buffered 3 bytes, waiting for continuation
keepalive: \n\n
'  <-- keepalive event dropped subsequent bytes in older parser
```
chris_oncall: We saw something similar in eng-repro a while back. Root cause was the SSE incremental decoder relying on text.decode('utf-8') per-chunk instead of an IncrementalDecoder, and an empty data event (keepalive) discarded the partial buffer incorrectly.
sam_runtime: I can repro locally with an artificial chunker. Confirmed on redwood-python 0.10.2 and server 1.8.x. When chunk boundaries split multi-byte sequences and there's a keepalive event between, parser path that applies `.strip()` to the event payload returned '' and we didn't merge buffered bytes back. Quick mitigation: use codecs.getincrementaldecoder('utf-8')() and feed bytes into it; it'll return '' for incomplete sequences and produce characters when completed. Also treat keepalive as event separator but don't drop partial buffer.
jonathan_eng: Good. Can we add a defensive fallback: if UnicodeDecodeError occurs, stash raw bytes in per-sse-event buffer and attempt incremental decode on next event rather than throwing away? Also add test with random chunk splits + multibyte chars.
sam_runtime: Yep. I'll open PR with two changes: 1) switch decoder to IncrementalDecoder; 2) ensure keepalive/empty events don't clear the buffer. Unit tests: fuzzing chunk splits including emoji and CJK characters.
mira_support: Customer impacted is on Dedicated and seeing elevated latency because clients hang and retry, doubling token billing — they're concerned. I escalated to AE and opened INC-24591. Can eng add workaround we can send to customer? Something like pin the python sdk to 0.10.3-dev with a patch? They prefer a hotfix.
sam_runtime: I'll cut a patch release 0.10.3 with the decoder fix and an opt-in env var REDWOOD_SSE_SAFE_DECODE=1 to enable incremental decoding immediately. Will post the release notes here when done.
deploy-bot: deploy pipeline started for redwood-python@0.10.3-patch (CI: green) — rolling canary.
mira_support: Thanks — please also include repro steps for support: small script that mimics the chunker and uses requests to stream SSE with deliberately broken multi-byte boundaries. I'll attach that to INC-24591 once PR merges.
jonathan_eng: Adding test matrix to CI for 0.10.3: windows/linux/mac, python 3.9-3.11, and ensure behavior with rotated creds and backoff. Also add a telemetry gauge to count stalled generators so we can alert.
sam_runtime: Patch PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/redwood-python/pull/512 (WIP). Will update when merged.
mira_support: OK, marking this thread resolved for now — will update when customer confirms after patch. :thumbsup:
